guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: bright jangly clean rhythm with light compression
tone.profile: bright jangly clean rhythm with light compression
tone.summary: A classic jangly rhythm tone achieved using a Comp boost for attack, followed by a clean British combo amp model (UK 50 or US Deluxe) paired with a bright cab, finished with minimal Room reverb.

rig.name: The Beatles - All My Loving - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and background noise.
Provide tight clean attack and sustain for percussive strumming.
Keep the tone clean and avoid crunch or fuzz.
Simulate the bright, clean sound of a Vox/Fender combo amp.
blocks.gap: The UK 50 is an approximation; US Deluxe or Silver Twin could also work for pure Fender tones.

alternatives.reason: Closer to a classic American clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and articulate sound suitable for jangly rhythm guitar.
blocks.gap: While the UK Vintage 4x12 is used, US 2x12 or Mess 4x12 might better capture the 'Fender' vibe.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright upper mids and jangle characteristic.
No wah needed; keep the tone direct and jangly.
Avoid chorus as per the 'avoid' list and instructions.
Add subtle depth and rhythmic definition without sounding distracting.
blocks.gap: A simpler, less noticeable delay might be better for pure jangly rhythm.

blocks.purpose: Provide the requested 'slight room' ambience without heavy reverb.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current UK IR for a US-style 2x12 or Mess 4x12 to better capture the classic Fender/Rickenbacker jangle tone.

proposals.reason: Better captures pure American clean tones and Rickenbacker jangle vibe.
